cards.text:
A return authorization to a packing and drop-off video
How it works

Check the return deadline and combine authorized items with ordered return instructions. Run the included sample manually or POST the required JSON to the webhook. The workflow applies deterministic business rules and creates a branded 1280×720 MP4 with vector graphics and text. The output contains the source key, calculated metadata, credit quote and completed video URL. Delivery and social publishing can be added after reviewing the result.

Setup
Install @zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid from Settings → Community nodes before configuring Zvid credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
Create a Zvid API credential at https://app.zvid.io/api-keys with Base URL https://api.zvid.io. Select it on all four Zvid nodes.
Required input: returnNumber, deadline, referenceDate, items, steps. Edit Sample input or send the same shape to Receive event.
Edit Config. The default dryRun: false renders and spends credits after checking maxRenderCredits. Set dryRun: true for an editor draft and quote.
Review Watch video → Binary → data → View. The webhook returns an immediate 202 acknowledgement; open its execution for the result.
Customization

Change brandName, accentColor, sceneSeconds and the bounded polling controls in Config. Exact input rules are in the included return-instructions-video.md companion; Zvid documentation covers API setup. Support: https://zvid.io/contact

cards.text:
1. Choose input

Run the included sample manually, or POST JSON to Receive event. The webhook acknowledges immediately; its execution contains the eventual result. Edit Config before rendering.
cards.title: 1. Choose input

cards.text:
2. Apply the business rules

Normalize required fields and calculate the actual brief. Empty eligible input produces a visible zero-work result and skips validation and rendering.
cards.title: 2. Apply the business rules

cards.text:
3. Validate and control credits

Zvid checks the project free of render charges. Reject invalid input, unavailable quotes and quotes above maxRenderCredits before choosing draft or paid rendering.
cards.title: 3. Validate and control credits

cards.text:
4. Optional editor draft

Only dryRun=true enters this branch. Open editorLink and inspect the quoted credits. A draft-save error remains visible in editorDraftError.
cards.title: 4. Optional editor draft

cards.text:
5. Render once and retain the URL

Paid submission has no automatic retries. Poll the accepted job within the configured wait budget; Video result keeps its completed URL and source metadata.
cards.title: 5. Render once and retain the URL

cards.text:
6. Watch the completed MP4

Completed media only: Watch video → Binary → data → View. Downloads have a 30-second timeout and at most three attempts. The result URL survives a failed preview.
cards.title: 6. Watch the completed MP4
